The most capable model: text inside pictures, busy scenes, people. Slow on a phone (about 10 minutes a picture), fast on a computer with a graphics card. Needs 12 GB RAM.

Faster and sharper than Turbo, with a better match to what you ask for: about 20 seconds a picture on the CPU. 512 px. For phones with 8 GB RAM or more.
Pro on this phone's CPU: 10–20 min a picture
This phone's graphics chip isn't working with Studio, so the Pro model would take 10–20 minutes a picture on the CPU. Studio Turbo makes a picture in about a minute.
Fast pictures on any phone: about a minute without a graphics chip, seconds with one. 512 px — great for ideas, drafts and posts.

The best photo quality: people, places, products and text in pictures, 1024 px. Also edits a photo you give it (“make it night”, “remove the car”). Needs a working graphics chip — on the CPU a picture takes 10–20 minutes.
Studio Pro at full precision: finer detail, cleaner faces, hands and text. Also edits your photos by instruction. Needs a working graphics chip and 12 GB RAM.
